Pediatric 3D-QALAS Brain MRI Dataset

This dataset contains source 3D-QALAS/MAGIC brain MRI image components
from 26 pediatric participants included in the associated Pediatric
Radiology publication.

Most participants have five available image components. Participant
sub-023 has three components in the available source export. No missing
components were synthesized, duplicated, or interpolated.

The files are source components of a single 3D-QALAS acquisition. They
are not conventional T1-weighted images and are not derived quantitative
T1, T2, or proton-density maps.

The run indices preserve component ordering and should not be interpreted
as separate scanner acquisitions.

Associated publication:
Ferraciolli SF, Jun Y, Valencia S, et al.
3D-QALAS synthetic MRI with Zero-DeepSub in children: initial experience
including post-contrast imaging feasibility.
Pediatric Radiology. 2026;56:867-877.
doi:10.1007/s00247-025-06510-0
